name: work
description: Hook-based project lifecycle management — injects branch context on every prompt, reminds task updates on stop, manages worktrees (toggle via WORK_USE_WORKTREE), and guards force-operations (toggle via WORK_GUARD). Protected branches customizable via WORK_PROTECTED_BRANCHES (comma-separated, default master,main,develop). v2.47.0: branches are named `{type}/{title}` (no PR-number prefix); internal IDs continue in index.yaml for cross-reference only. Section names renamed: 関連PR → 関連ブランチ, 次PR候補 → 次ブランチ候補. v2.48.0: notes-to-claude skill removed (inter-plugin dependency eliminated). v2.49.0: drop NEXT_KIT_TS_CHECK / INJECTION_DISABLE entries from work:plugin-config (managed by /dev-kit:plugin-config or excluded by policy); migrate Step 2 to numbered list. v2.50.0: add WORK_BRANCH_AUTHOR env var to insert author name into branch names ({type}/{author}/{title}). v2.51.0: add WORK_COMMIT_LANG / WORK_COMMIT_TYPE env vars to configure commit message language and type prefix. v2.53.0: redefine notes as a current spec sheet (snapshot — present state only, no history in the body; change recorded only in a trailing 変更履歴 table; no YAML frontmatter); add ノート記述内容ルール reference injected on .work/notes/** edits; remove .work/specs (content merged into notes). v2.53.1: split references/ into category subfolders (notes/, work-dir/, skill-sync/). v2.55.0: remove plugins/work/templates/ and setup-task.py — templates and per-folder structure definitions move into references/work-dir/ (タスクドキュメント / タスクインデックス / イシュー / ワークディレクトリ構成), injected by ref-inject when creating/editing the matching .work/ path (Write hook). work:start authors the branch document directly from the injected template. Branch document filename gains the .branch.md extension so the task folder can also hold user files. Rename ドットワークディレクトリ構成→ワークディレクトリ構成; remove TODOテンプレート同期. v2.56.0: redesign issue-scan as an orchestrator that delegates scanning to parallel work:issue-scanner subagents (new agent), scanning by perspective (folder/grep/layer/file-group/pattern) with ISSUE_SCAN_AGENTS setting the count; remove issue-save skill — the issue file format/numbering now lives in the work-dir/イシュー reference (auto-injected on .work/issues edits), authored directly by issue-create and issue-scanner. v2.57.0: task folder names are now Japanese ({YYMMDD}_{日本語タイトル}); existing 217 folders renamed in bulk, index.archive.yaml task: fields followed, and work:start / work-dir references updated to the Japanese-name convention. v2.58.0: add work:setup-wizard skill and SessionStart hook (setup_check.py); first-run onboarding writes setup_done: true to .claude/work.local.md.
